name: Planner
author: brodgar
description: Example addon (V4/V5/V6): the LAYOUT + GRID-ANCHORED PERSISTENCE + full TRANSFORM demo for client-only world ghosts (hafen.ghost). A small city/base planner — place translucent 'blueprint' ghosts over the real terrain, CLICK them to select (V2), transform them with a Unity-style GIZMO (':planner gizmo' — drag the RED(X)/GREEN(Y) arrows or yellow centre to MOVE, the cyan RING to ROTATE, the magenta BOX to SCALE) or move by the body (V5a, ':planner grab'), and SAVE the layout so it reloads at the SAME spot — with facing AND scale — after a relog. The gizmo is a BUNDLED LUA LIBRARY (gizmo.lua) over the Java primitives (D-031): handles are drawn with g:draw() (no game resources), projected from the world each frame; move/rotate snap to the client's :placegrid/:placeangle (SHIFT=fine, D-033), scale is uniform (g:scale). Ghosts are SAFE-tier (a Gob with no server id, D-029): nothing reaches the server, so this addon declares NO permissions and is default-enabled like 'hello'. Persistence is GRID-ANCHORED: world coords are login-relative, so each ghost is saved as hafen.map.gridPos(x,y) => {gridId, x, y} (a stable cross-session grid id + within-grid offset) + its facing + scale, and re-resolved on load with hafen.map.fromGridPos(anchor) (nil until that grid streams in — retried), the same rule map markers follow. Commands: ':planner place [name|res]' drops the current/named blueprint at your feet (clickable + saved); 'blueprint [name]' shows/sets it (bare = list the palette); 'list'; 'select <n>' (or CLICK a ghost); 'gizmo [move|rotate|scale|all]' attaches the transform gizmo; 'grab' MOVES by the body (placegrid-snapped, CLICK to drop); 'rotate [deg]' / 'scale <s>' set facing/scale directly (persisted); 'remove [n]' / 'clear' / 'save'. Kept SEPARATE from the read-only 'hello' regression harness as the dedicated V-series example (spec 16-virtual-entities, D-031).
